description: Public parameters of risk_progress_v3 (analytics/holy_grail/risk_progress_v3.py): modeled private streams by class:country and listed proxy baskets. Literature and public-index values only; no holdings. Changing any value needs a new file and method version.

conventions.stream: r = beta*F + sigma_res*(sqrt(s_c)*g_country + sqrt(s_k)*h_class_country + sqrt(s_l)*k_location); one stream per class, country and location; no idiosyncratic term
conventions.vol_annual: annual USD volatility, unlevered, total return, desmoothed where possible; the central value is always used (x0.5/x2 sensitivity reported separately)
conventions.correlations: with the factor representatives (equity_us, treasury_medium, commodities, optional EURUSD=X); low <= central <= high; favorable uses low, adverse uses high
conventions.share_scenarios: residual variance shares country/class_country/location summing to 1; low = low country dependence
conventions.no_country_factor: US risk sits in the factors; other means no single country
conventions.cash_eligible: only these rows may declare nav_source cash (the value is already in CASH_DATA); USD cash, including USD deposits in Ukrainian banks, stays cash and outside the score
conventions.access_non_accredited: how a non-accredited individual can hold the class (Reg CF, Reg A and 506(b) possible; 506(c) accredited only)

car_link_rho_documentation.definition: corr(car-business residual, g_UA); residual = rho g + sqrt(1-rho^2) e
car_link_rho_documentation.rationale: USD-priced imported used cars; demand tied to UA incomes, FX and war (2022 collapse then duty-free import surge); policy-specific customs shocks keep it below the FX/sovereign s_c^0.5 (~0.75-0.77). No measured series found.

sources.note: not searched in this revision (time box spent on housing and Eurobond data); value unchanged

infrastructure.label: Brookfield listed infrastructure and renewable vehicles

private_equity.label: listed alternative asset managers (equity beta dominates)

known_model_gaps.iberian_cycle: ES vs PT housing residuals after F correlate 0.69 (q) / 0.88 (a); the model treats g_ES and g_PT as independent, overstating ES+PT diversification
known_model_gaps.euro_rates: euro-area rate shocks (2022) hit DE/ES/PT property together but IEF is a US Treasury factor; cross-country residual corr DE-ES 0.16, DE-PT 0.16 (q) stays low over 2006-2026

changelog: US and other rows unchanged from assumptions_v3.json.
UA rows replaced by params_ua/ua_rows.json (residential_re:UA measured from LUN city series; commercial_re:UA vol 0.22 -> 0.20 judgement; others unchanged).

Added global rows from params_global/global_rows.json: commercial_re:DE, commercial_re:ES, commercial_re:PL, residential_re:AE, residential_re:DE, residential_re:ES, residential_re:GE, residential_re:PL, residential_re:PT.
Dropped farmland:PL: not purchasable by the target investor: Polish law restricts farmland buyers to farmers; non-EU buyers also need an Interior Ministry permit.
Weak rows kept with flags: commercial_re:PL (institutional deals index over EUR 5m), residential_re:GE (judgement, no continuous series), residential_re:AE (BIS offer prices to 2024-04).
Accepted the global agent regime fix for DE/ES/PT central correlation vectors (consistency with the 60-month factor matrix; no score was computed when it was made).
Model gap: ES and PT residuals correlate 0.69-0.88 (Iberian cycle) but country factors are independent; the global reference R8 therefore holds only one Iberian country.
Optional 4th factor EURUSD=X: used only by rows that declare corr_fx_eur (EUR beta 0 otherwise), so US/UA/other rows are unaffected.
